## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/chat`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ChatComponent`](/api/chat/ChatComponent) | Component | A conversation: its messages, by day, with the user's at the end and others' at the start beside their avatar, and a message box below them. |
| [`ChatAttachmentTemplateDirective`](/api/chat/ChatAttachmentTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each file sent with a message, in place of its picture, name and size, such as a preview of a document. |
| [`ChatEmptyTemplateDirective`](/api/chat/ChatEmptyTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for a chat with no messages, in place of "No messages yet", such as a greeting from an assistant. |
| [`ChatMessageTemplateDirective`](/api/chat/ChatMessageTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each message's content, inside its bubble, in place of its text, such as text rendered from Markdown. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`CHAT_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/chat/CHAT_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`ChatAttachment`](/api/chat/ChatAttachment) | Interface | A file sent with a message. |
| [`ChatAttachmentTemplateContext`](/api/chat/ChatAttachmentTemplateContext) | Interface | The context of a `monaChatAttachmentTemplate`: the file, as `let-attachment`. |
| [`ChatMessage`](/api/chat/ChatMessage) | Interface | A message in a chat. |
| [`ChatMessageTemplateContext`](/api/chat/ChatMessageTemplateContext) | Interface | The context of a `monaChatMessageTemplate`: the message, as `let-message`. |
| [`ChatSendEvent`](/api/chat/ChatSendEvent) | Interface | What the user sends: their message's text, trimmed, and the files they attached to it. |
| [`ChatUser`](/api/chat/ChatUser) | Interface | Someone taking part in a chat: the user, or someone they're talking to, a person or an assistant. |
| [`ChatMessageStatus`](/api/chat/ChatMessageStatus) | Type alias | Where a message of the user's stands: `"sending"`, shown faded with "Sending" under it, `"sent"`, or `"failed"`, with "Not sent" and a Retry button under it. |

**Related types:** [`MonaChatMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaChatMessages)
